# GTM Positioning Strategy

Curated by Skill Harbor — a free, open-source skill (MIT), listed here with credit to its contributor Smit Patel, via the github/awesome-copilot collection. Discovered via skills.sh. A positioning audit for products whose messaging sounds like everyone else's: find and own a defensible market position using competitive alternatives, unique attributes, value themes, and target-market characteristics — with a crawl-walk-run rollout method and the worked example of the single word change ("autonomous" → "AI teammate") that measurably sped up enterprise deal progression. Honest notes: positioning advice, not market data — it won't tell you what competitors actually charge or what buyers actually think; its frameworks are B2B-tech-shaped, adapt them for consumer or services; testing positioning claims takes real conversations with prospects, which the skill can't have for you. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
